## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete user problem and what changes after this PR.

## Validation

List checks run and observed results. For UI changes, include sanitized screenshots and the browser flow tested. Distinguish deterministic fixtures from real model evidence.

## Compatibility and remaining limits

Call out data-format, permission, dependency and public-contract changes, and anything still unverified.

- [ ] Relevant build/tests or documentation checks pass.
- [ ] Current docs and both READMEs are updated where behavior changes.
- [ ] No keys, conversations, browser profiles or private files are included.
- [ ] Copied third-party code retains source and license notices.
